text:
morgan: Big shoutout to lee and aria for swooping in on the last-minute metrics spike before the partner demo. you two saved the day :raised_hands:

lee: no problem — found a bad retention filter in the dashboard code, pushed a tiny fix and a hotpatch to the query. PR: https://git.internal/r/9042

aria: nailed it together. also left a short note in the dashboard runbook so its easier to spot next time.

kevin: sending confetti! proposing macarons in the kitchen as a thank-you. whos in? :macaron:

morgan: YES. macarons + a sticker pack for the infra heroes. ideas for sticker copy?

lee: "Macaron Maestro" or "Signal Sniffer" — either works for me.

aria: love both. also +1 to a tiny enamel pin.

people-ops: added lee + aria to this week's kudos board and allocated $20 snack credit each :trophy:

ops-bot: FYI: free snack delivery scheduled for Friday 3pm in HQ kitchen :package:

kevin: poll: macarons friday at 3pm? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :smile: for maybe, :wave: if you can bring coffee.

morgan: also, quick note — leaving a one-line blurb for the partner folks so they dont get a weird spike in the postmortem. small wins matter.

lee: thanks everyone. totally made my week. :grin:

aria: appreciate the shoutout! ok macarons it is.

people-ops: will follow up tomorrow with sticker mockups and a short order form.
